26:@usableFromInline
27:package enum ObservableStateError: UInt8, Error, Equatable, Sendable {
28:    case locationCapacityExhausted = 0
29:    case registrationCapacityExhausted = 1
30:    case associationStagingCapacityExhausted = 2
31:    case replacementStagingCapacityExhausted = 3
32:    case registrationGenerationExhausted = 4
33:    case duplicateOwner = 5
34:    case incompatibleAssociation = 6
35:    case staleAttachment = 7
36:    case invalidPhaseContained = 8
37:    case invalidPhaseSafetyNotProven = 9
38:    case reentrancyViolation = 10
39:    case invariantViolation = 11
40:    case modelCapacityExhausted = 12
41:    case ownerCapacityExhausted = 13
42:    case retainedModel = 14
43:    case modelGenerationExhausted = 15
44:    case staleModel = 16
45:    case modelReadOutOfBounds = 17
46:
47:    package init(accessFailure: _GiftUIAccessFailure) {
48:        switch accessFailure {
49:        case .invalidPhase: self = .invalidPhaseSafetyNotProven
50:        case .wrongOwner, .wrongSchema, .staleModel: self = .staleModel
51:        case .outOfBounds: self = .modelReadOutOfBounds
52:        }
53:    }
54:}

57:package enum ObservableStateOperational: UInt8, Equatable, Sendable {
58:    case unchanged = 0
59:    case candidateStarted = 1
60:    case materialized = 2
61:    case preserved = 3
62:    case candidateDiscarded = 4
63:    case associationsCommitted = 5
64:    case replaced = 6
65:    case dirtied = 7
66:    case coalesced = 8
67:}
68:
69:@usableFromInline
70:package enum ObservableStateResult: Equatable, Sendable {
71:    case success(ObservableStateOperational)
72:    case failure(ObservableStateError)
73:}
